<Subject 2> is the abandoned town: old plaster and adobe houses with clay-tile roofs, completely empty of people, a small whitewashed church tower with a bronze bell, and the jungle growing back over its edges.

detailed_description:
The target video is a living aged tempera painting in <Subject 1>: the cracked pigment and dry-brush texture stay visible on every surface as it moves, and the light changes like paint glazing over paint.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The bell keeps swinging slowly in the arch. The camera pushes forward through the open belfry arch at a slow, steady speed in one continuous move, passing just beside the swinging bell and out the other side of the tower, then gliding gently down toward the back of the town, where thick jungle vines and broad leaves cover an old wall. Behind the leaves a faded mural of fully clothed musicians playing marimba and guitar comes into view, morning light falling through the canopy onto their painted faces. The camera is still gliding as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.

overall_soundscape:
The bell's hum fading behind, then rustling leaves, dripping dew, insects and birds waking in the jungle, and a single soft marimba note as if remembered by the painted wall.
